title: FirST lines of biologics in pAtients with ulceRaTivE colitis: a Randomised controlled trial
official: FirST lines of biologics in pAtients with ulceRaTivE colitis: a Randomised controlled trial
summary: Main objective: To compare strategies starting with the use of anti-integrins (vedolizumab), JAK inhibitors (filgotinib), anti-IL12/23 (ustekinumab) or anti-TNF agents (infliximab) as first line of advanced therapy to maintain remission in patients with ulcerative colitis.

interventions.name: Entyvio 300 mg powder for concentrate for solution for infusion
Remsima 100 mg powder for concentrate for solution for infusion
STEQEYMA 130 mg concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. -	Male or female patients (using effective contraception and a negative pregnancy test for women of childbearing age) diagnosed with UC for at least 3 months
2. -	Age ≥ 18 years and ≤ 65 years
3. -	Moderate to severe UC according to modified Mayo score (from 5 to 9)
4. -	With endoscopic Mayo score ≥ 2
5. -	With an inadequate response, failure, loss of response, or intolerance to 5-ASA, steroids, or immunosuppressants.
6. -	Patient capable of giving consent
7. -	Patient covered by the French healthcare system
Exclusion criteria:
1. -	Usual contra-indication to infliximab, filgotinib, vedolizumab or ustekinumab
2. -	Prior exposure to other biologics or experimental drug
3. -	No health insurance
4. -	Pregnant or lactating women : a pregnancy test will be performed for women of childbearing age
5. -	Patients already included in biomedical research other than an observational study (e.g: registry, cohort)
6. -	Concomitant Clostridioides difficile infection
7. -	HIV infection
8. -	Patient who does not master the French language
9. -	Patient under guardianship, curatorship or safeguard of justice
10. -	Minors
11. -	Steroids > 20 mg/day within two weeks before inclusion
12. -	Low proctitis (disease limited to the rectum with an extent < 5 cm)
13. -	Prior history of thromboembolism events
14. -	Prior history of major cardiovascular problems (such as heart attack or stroke)
15. -	Long-standing smokers (> 40 pack years)
16. -	Crohn's disease
17. -	Stoma or colectomy
18. -	Prior exposure to anti-TNF agents, anti-integrins, anti-interleukines 12 and 23 or JAK inhibitor
